item.title: I've had free access to some of the world's best gaming mice, but I always come back to this $27 champion that refuses to die
item.description: Logitech's G305 Lightspeed wireless gaming mouse hasn't left my desk for over 5 years, and sometimes it feels like its single AA battery lasts forever, too.

item.title: Razer’s new 16-inch laptop sleeve doubles as a wireless charger, but is it worth $130?
item.description: Razer’s new Laptop Sleeve 16" with Wireless Charging is a premium 3-in-1 accessory for gamers and creators. While it offers dual MagSafe-compatible charging zones and rugged protection, the $130 price tag and lack of an internal battery raise questions about its overall value. Here is everything you need to know about Razer's latest everyday carry essential.

item.title: Here's exactly when you can play Call of Duty's new Black Ops Royale — Blackout comes back to Warzone
item.description: Black Ops Royale is the new Blackout-inspired battle royale experience for Call of Duty: Warzone. But when can you drop in and play?

item.title: Black Ops Royale is Call of Duty: Warzone's big update — Activision delivers a massive intel drop inspired by Black Ops 4, and it's coming sooner than you might think
item.description: Activision has revealed Black Ops Royale for Call of Duty: Warzone, a mode inspired by Black Ops 4 BR set on the Avalon map.

item.title: Do you need to own Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 to play the new Blackout-inspired Black Ops Royale?
item.description: Blackout is coming back to Call of Duty with Black Ops Royale. But do you need to actually own Black Ops 7 to play it?

item.title: The Fallout 3 and New Vegas remasters may have their developer — it's in charge of a big Xbox exclusive, and has worked on Bethesda's RPGs before
item.description: A new teaser from a game development studio suggests it's working on the upcoming Fallout 3 and New Vegas remasters.

item.title: Whoa, Xbox may be teasing Cyberpunk 2077 coming to Game Pass — "Something v cool is coming soon"
item.description: CD PROJEKT RED's Cyberpunk 2077 is a hugely popular RPG, and a new tease from Microsoft and Xbox suggest it could come to Game Pass soon.

item.title: "The sub-$500 entry-level PC segment will disappear by 2028" — Rising memory costs are driving cheap PCs to extinction, and 2026 is when it all begins
item.description: According to a senior analyst at Gartner, the sub-$500 PC market will have completely disappeared by 2028 due to rising component costs. It's not exactly a surprise, but it is a dire warning to anyone who needs a new laptop.

item.title: Microsoft accidentally kicked off a Copilot revolt by banning the word “Microslop” on Discord
item.description: Microsoft briefly blocked the term “Microslop” in its official Copilot Discord server, leading to user backlash, filter workarounds, and a temporary lockdown. The incident highlights broader frustration around Windows AI and Copilot adoption.

item.title: Apple is begging for your attention this week — but this $600 discount makes Lenovo’s Yoga AIO 27" a real iMac killer
item.description: While Apple floods the zone with iPhone 17e and iPad Air news, the Lenovo Yoga AIO 27" is stealing the show with a $600 discount and a rotating screen the iMac can't touch.
